def transform(grid):
    # A uniform separator divides two same-sized binary panels. Their sole
    # shared color is the overlap signal: mark cells where both panels contain
    # that color with 3, and use that shared color elsewhere.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    shared = next(v for v in {x for row in top for x in row}
                  if any(v in row for row in bottom))
    return [[3 if a == shared and b == shared else shared
             for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
